_caps: A grant never exceeds its table's cap (no day cap since 2026-09-23 — 体力 alone limits a day).
_economy: 2026-09-24 (his: games cost a little 体力, the card fight is the best 修为 per 体力). 修为 per 体力 at 练气: haunt 25/8 = 3.1 (2.7 expected at the gate's ~85% win) · elite 38/12 = 3.2 (2.1 expected at ~65%) · a hosted game 5/3 = 1.7 · 论道 6/3 = 2.0 — every one below a fight even at the fight's odds. A normal 练气 day in 徐 — two haunts and a road beast (3 fights, ~2.5 won ≈ 64), the six games (30), story and errands (~20) — is ~115, so 练气's 810 takes about a week. 开府 (a setup milestone, paid once ever, table `once`) 40 修为 + 20 灵石 — twelve of them are ~480, four ordinary days, once in a life. Before: the games alone paid 180 for no 体力, and 练气 took about three days.
_tale: 今日传闻 (design.md § 今日传闻): Ling writes no number. Each step pays the `tale` table and the finale the `tale_end` table, both capped; the whole tale never pays more than `cap` (a fifth step eats into the finale), and pay() scales it by the roots, the day's cast and the realm like any grant. One finale `drop`: the highest-tier entry at or below the player's realm (an item, or a card not held and of a root the player has), picked by the tale's id. Economy: a step costs its board's 体力 (stamina.cost.game, 3) plus the walk; a 4-step tale with an elite finale is ~36 体力 for 40 + 25 修为 here plus the elite's own 38 — ~2.9 per 体力, just under a fight's 3.1, the walking being the difference.
_stamina: stamina is the pace — design.md § 灵气. Refills by the clock, full in refill_hours; actions cost it; a quest paid refills it (the app's own `qi`, else refill.quest).

bond._about: 银月 beside the player (redesign-v2 § 四: no relationship score). What walking together gives her card comes from the story alone: the chapters ended. 相知/相惜/同心 are no longer counted or shown; the lifts are the ones the gate measured (2026-09-23): +1/+1 at most — +2/+2 won 97%, which is not a fight.

_growth: 本命法宝 and 符 grow from the story, never from a daily tap (redesign-v2 § 四: 温养 · 强化 · 写符 cut). The treasure rises one 重 each time a chapter ends and each time 今日传闻's finale is won, up to 九重. A rumor's finale leaves one 符; a fight won leaves one on one win in `fight_one_in` (by the day, the beast and the 道号).
